message: border-radius isn't supported in Outlook Windows; partly in Yahoo! Mail Desktop Webmail, Yahoo! Mail iOS, Yahoo! Mail Android (4 places)
hint: Round corners can be used in VML with the `RoundRect` element. See the [VML documentation](https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/vml/msdn-online-vml-roundrect-element).

message: <a href> around a block: the link moves onto the 2 text runs or images inside
hint: Email clients can't make a whole box a link (Outlook drops a link around a table), so each text run and image inside gets the href; the padding between them isn't clickable.
